'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a mob drop, gained by defeating a [[monsters|poppet]], found only within the deeper levels of the [[dungeon]]. Its only known use is being a product for death-related reagents, used in [[alchemy]].

==Alchemy==
{{PAGENAME}} can be decomposed into a [[death solution|solution]] and [[death extract|extract]] with the [[hand mixer]] and any of the distillation cubes, respectively. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] produces one additional reagent at any workstation.
